decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template is cheap to maintain, close to the core agency hosting offer and still early in resolving its value, so keeping the option open is sensible.
The responsive template costs little to keep and supports hosting sales, though its low visibility on the website leaves its value uncertain rather than disproven.
Premium support builds directly on the firm's round-the-clock expert support and fits its agency-focused strategy, so it is a low-cost option with likely recurring value.
The version management tool has its own page and fits the firm's goal of tools that reduce recurring operational work, so further commitment looks justified.
The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but GDPR-driven demand is still unfolding and a small online tool is cheap to keep, so abandoning it now would be premature.
